title: Stage ascent receipt (ONE rung) — CANDIDATE, non-binding
description: Pays exactly one rung of a producer's custody ladder for one artifact kind. A stage-n profile does not authorize stage n+1; an ascent j→k is a CONTIGUOUS CHAIN of these receipts, every intermediate rung in custody — no skipped rung, no bulk discount, no multi-rung receipt representable. The unit-step law (to_stage == from_stage + 1) and chain contiguity are gate-enforced invariants; JSON Schema cannot express the arithmetic.

to_stage.description: MUST equal from_stage + 1 (gate-enforced; a receipt violating unit-step is refused, not reinterpreted).

paid_by.description: Evidence reference for what earned this rung (the survival event: review passed, drill survived, ratification minted...). In the producer's idiom.
